text: Kirin Tor Invokers are humans who briefly appear in the Hall of the Guardian. After being trained by Grand Conjurer Mimic, they run out of the hall. They also appear as worgen, pandaren, draenei, and jungle trolls, gnomes, blood elves, and orcs serving as the troops accompanying the Class Hall champions.
Kindred Affinity is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Kindred Affinity.
Kindled Furies are fire elementals found in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

The Knights of the Silver Hand (full name the Order of the Knights of the Silver Hand, often referred to as the Order of the Silver Hand, the Paladins of the Silver Hand, the Silver Hand, or the Paladin Order) is the order of holy knights and warriors, commonly called paladins, created by Archbishop Alonsus Faol as the martial branch of the Church of Light. Empowered by the Holy Light, these mighty warriors brandish both their warhammers and holy fire in the battle against all who would trample the meek and innocent, as they seek to be an example of the Light's teachings, protecting the weak and vanquishing the evil of the world. Under the command of the Uther the Lightbringer, they led the

Knights are traditionally powerful horse-mounted warriors of the Alliance and the kingdoms of humanity. They are usually humans, although other factions have knights as well such as the elves. Many famous human warriors were knights such as Sir Anduin Lothar, Regent of Stormwind and Supreme Commander of the Alliance forces during the Second War. For centuries they have been the bane of many enemies: the legendary Orgrim Doomhammer, the warchief who fell Lothar, was indeed killed by a human knight. These legendary mounted warriors also proved to be a decisive factor in many battles; particularly in the Gnoll War and the First Siege of Stormwind Keep. Orcs in particular respected and feared th

Knock back (also known as punting) is an effect that lifts an enemy off the ground and knocks them back a certain distance, without dismounting mounted players. Player abilities with knock back effects were implemented in Wrath of the Lich King. Previously, they had been much sought after by players, traditionally only being given to bosses, mobs or NPCs.

Klink Pakkuri is a tinker. According to him at least 237 devices have been created because a tinker saw a spell fail and wanted to one-up the caster — all of them his. He got tired of the failed spells of the human mage he used to travel with, and decided to show him how things were supposed to be done. During one stop in Theramore to help the mage recuperate from the wounds he received on their last adventure, Klink started thinking about how dangerous it was to travel with his friend, and what the chances were they would get into more trouble if he went out again. Kixa is, along with Branzlit, Perixa and Rilgiz one of four bankers in the Bank of Orgrimmar which is located in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar. After the failed Battle for Broken Shore, she was seen talking with an Orgrimmar Grunt. After Vol'jin's death, she was speaking with Grunt Koma.

Your war could last a thousand years and it would be but a small river feeding into the ocean of the Klaxxi's plans. Their will is to preserve the cycle.The will of the Klaxxi is eternal. The Klaxxi are mantid elders untouched by the corruption and insanity that has overtaken the remainder of the mantid swarm. They seek to replace the corrupted empress and reluctantly accept the aid of the player. Knowledge of the Ancients is a Restoration druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Persistence (druid artifact trait), Seeds of the World Tree and Power of the Archdruid (artifact trait) traits.
Kixi the Shiv was a goblin battlemaster located in Shattrath City.

The Knucklebump gorillas can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

Kitala Starshadow is a Darkfallen dark ranger first seen in the Hall of Ritual in Dazar'alor as "Captain Kitala", guarding Derek Proudmoore before he was rescued. After Sylvanas Windrunner abandoned the Forsaken, Kitala briefly appeared at the Calston Estate with other lost dark rangers to seek help from Calia Menethil.

Kivarr is a :soulshape located at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald. She was once a Thornspeaker and was Ulfar's teacher. When she arrived in Ardenweald, the grove of Darkreach had not been corrupted by the Drust. She personally knew Gorak Zhar and Ingra Drif.
Knowledge of Mortality is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Kiss of Recklessness is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Kiss of Death is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Kiss of Death.

Rexxar and Rokhan were given a mission by Engineer Gazlowe to destroy the Kobold mining columns east of Durotar because they were causing problems. With the help of Goblin Sappers, Rexxar's forces accomplished this mission.
Komin Winterhoof is a tauren herbalism trainer located in the Holistic Herbalism shop on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Kodo mounts are mostly Horde only mounts. They were originally added as a replacement for plainsrunning (a tauren ability).
Kokorek's Signet is an ring. It gives bonuses to strength, stamina, and critical strike. This is Kokorek's ring.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Defenders are orcs of Kor'kron located at Shadowmoon Valley.
Kor'kron Riders are orcs of Kor'kron located at Shadowmoon Valley.

:"Come then, you ragged sacks of flesh. Come and learn what it takes to slay an elf." Koltira Deathweaver is a notable death knight of the New Horde, serving as the Horde counterpart to Thassarian. In life, Koltira was a valiant defender of Quel'Thalas, and took to the field during the brutal Scourge invasion. He was killed in battle by Thassarian, and was promptly reanimated as a powerful death knight under the Lich King's sway. Despite Thassarian being his killer, Koltira came to develop a strong bond with the human, the two placing inordinate amounts of value on the safety of the other (for ruthless death knights of the Scourge), and considering each other brothers in death. Along with ma

The colossal Kodo Beasts of the Kalimdor plains proved to be valued allies of the Orcish Horde. The mighty beasts were charged with carrying the Orcs’ pounding war drums into battle. The huge kodos, serving as symbols of Orcish might and valor, also use their enormous size and strength to aid the Orcs in battle.
__NOTOC__ Kolkar Destroyers are centaur located in Desolace.
__NOTOC__ Kor'kron Troop Transport is a flying troop transport with a Kor'kron Suppression Turret attached on the front. This vehicle can be found in the Bombardment of Icecrown.

Komak was a grunt found patrolling the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Having been promoted to overseer, he is found holding an axe to Ji Firepaw's head during the Siege of Orgrimmar where he is killed.
Kobold War Horn is provided by Subjugator Devo to summon kobolds at the Horde Banner in the Unearthed Grounds in the Stonetalon Mountains for Kobold Fury.

Kor'kron Scouts are orcs of Kor'kron found in Ragefire Chasm. Commander Bagran sent a group of these scouts into the chasm for a routine patrol, searching for troggs and any other minor threats to the city. However, many of them befell danger in the form of the flame hounds, lava worms, and Dark Shaman that now reside within. One of them is hanging from a ridge above the lava, another is hidden behind a rock, another is cornered by flame hounds, a few of them are caged at the end of the dungeon. One deceased scout is located at the beginning of the dungeon. Invoker Xorenth is kneeling next to his body.

Kor'kron Dubs is an orc that can be found on the Hellscream's Fist in the Jade Forest. Along with Spisak, Jo'mag and Shin, he's one of the Kor'kron Guards that accompanied General Nazgrim to the new uncharted land. When the airship was burning in the Jade Forest, Dubs could be found kneeling on the border of the ship bridge, looking down, not far from Cannoneer Powell. Of the four Kor'kron, Dubs is the only one that (apparently) managed to leave the airship before it was taken down by Captain Doren. Shortly before the gunship was destroyed, when the Horde adventurers reached the top of Thunder Hold to kill Doren, he waited for them at the top of the stairs. Minutes later he was found dead, l

The Kor'kron Dark Shaman are the seventh boss encounter in the Siege of Orgrimmar. They are located within Grommash Hold in the Valley of Strength after the players break through the front gates. Haromm and Kardris Dreamseeker, formerly normal shaman Class trainers, now twist and bind the elements to their will as Dark Shaman. The encounter is very telegraph heavy, and contains numerous Stay out of the fire mechanics that turn the battle field into chaos in a small amount of time.
Kor'kron Provisioners are orcs found in the Valley of Strength during the Siege of Orgrimmar.

A kommu is some kind of animal found on the Darkspear Islands, possibly only within First Home. The Darkspear jungle trolls are known to eat kommu; before heading into First Home, Zalazane was chewing noisily on kommu meat, and several days later he and Vol'jin had captured one of the creatures and were turning it on a spit over a fire.
Kokorek's Talisman was provided as an objective for Primal Magic.
Kor'kron Annihilator is located in Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. A nearby grunt will sometimes walk up to it and laugh.
Konigin is a wolf located at Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains.
Konrad the Enslaver is a human located on the expedition islands.
Kobold Looters are kobolds that were located in the Stonetalon Mountains during beta testing.
Kobo Rayfriend is a gilgoblin flight master located at the Tidal Conflux in Nazjatar.
Kobold Overseer is a powerful kobold that can be encountered in Mulgore during Founding of Durotar campaign.
Koltira's Favor is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Koltira.

Kormok is an ogre necromancer boss found in Scholomance. One of his heads was always cheerful if not a little foolish, while the other was sly, calculating and had an almost dead look to its eyes. While initially a mere mage and not being that bad as a member of the Veiled Blade, he became exposed to the necromantic side of magic and ended up delighting in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle. After quitting his mercenary company he enrolled at the Scholomance but ended up assassinated by Lord Valthalak's minions. Kormok was one of the 4 random bosses that must be killed for the left or right piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet for the Dungeon Set 2 questline. He cou

.]] The Kosh'harg (sometimes called the Kosh'harg celebration or Kosh'harg festival) is a traditional orcish festival in which the various orc clans come together to share news and feast in friendship. For centuries, the Kosh'harg was held twice each year near the holy mountain of Oshu'gun on the orcs' homeworld of Draenor. The tradition was one of many that were lost during the rise of the Old Horde, but was revived decades later on Azeroth on the initiative of Eitrigg.

Korin was one of the survivors of the battle of Shattrath City. She was affected by the red mist, and in the months following her escape, started the change into Broken. She was disheartened further by the loss of Estes and Herac, her previous defenders, who devolved all the way to become Lost Ones. Eventually, she gave up all hope, and tossed herself off the edge of Outland, much to the dismay of Nobundo, who saw her but was too far away to intervene.
Kor'kron Wind Riders are orcs summoned using in Shadowmoon Valley.
Kor'kron Wyvern Riders are orcs of Kor'kron located at Shadowmoon Valley.
Kragh is an orc flight master located at Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills.

Koragg is a wight found in Zul'Aman as one of the eight possible adds for Hex Lord Malacrass. It can be shackled by a Priest or feared by a Paladin. It uses a knockback and a 20 yard AoE curse Cold Stare which deals 1414 to 1586 Frost damage if any spell or ability is used.

Krank Axeljink was a gnome from Tinker Town, chosen to be a gnomish representative to the New Council of Tirisfal. He invented a device that would draw power from the other council members into their chosen representative (which would, of course, be himself). When Cho'gall's elementals attacked Theramore Isle, he proclaimed that the time to use his device had come. Though Meryl Winterstorm felt the device would be utterly useless, Aegwynn said that they had little to lose and the council tried it anyway. The device exploded, killing Krank.

Korra is the frostsaber pet of . Both Korra and Raene are located in the inn at Astranaar in Ashenvale. Korra accompanied Raene to the Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain during the Burning Legion's third invasion.
__NOTOC__ Korrah's Hippogryph is a hippogryph flight master located at Ethel Rethor in Desolace.

Kozish is a goblin inside the inn of the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. Kor'kron orcs were seen threatening Doyo'da and Kozish in front of the inn. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, both of them were caged but soon released by the invading adventurers and left the battlefield.

Krasarang River is the western north-south river in Krasarang Wilds. Fed by the Krasari Falls coming from the Yan-Zhe River in Valley of the Four Winds, the river flows past Fallsong Village, Crane Wing Refuge, the Temple of the Red Crane, and Dawnchaser Retreat before emptying into the ocean around the Cradle of Chi-Ji.

Korven the Prime is a mantid located at Klaxxi'vess. He is the first Paragon of the Klaxxi and the one who mastered the art of using amber to preserve the Mantid's greatest warriors. This mastery also extends to his fighting style, which uses magic based around amber to harm others and protect himself from death.

Kotonga is a forest troll quest giver located at the Revantusk camp at the base of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. After completion of Death to the Vilebranch (Horde), Horde players can talk to Kotonga to teleport to the Totem of Akil'darah at the top of Jintha'Alor, allowing faster access to quest objectives. __NOTOC__
Dremm is a draenei leatherworking trainer and vendor located on Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.

Kra'kul was one of the orcs who fought the humans in the Blasted Lands to forbid them from entering the Dark Portal. He knew something about Malkor placing an object on the Portal. Malkor simply assured him that it was just a shield went to protect them when the orcs crossed over. The truth about this shield was that it was truly a bomb created by goblins to destroy the Dark Portal and kill anyone who was near it. When Khadgar launched it far to save everyone there, Grommash Hellscream accused Kra'kul of betrayal. Holding him high by his neck and fearing about his life, the warlock spilled the beans and told him all that he knew. It is unknown what became of him.

Kor Bloodtusk was part of the Dawnchaser expedition, led by Sunwalker Dezco, sent to Pandaria to follow "dreams of a valley, golden with blossoms, filled with the hope of peace". He appears to have been sent as a representative of Garrosh Hellscream, as he is the only non-tauren in the group and he makes reference to needing "soldiers of horde blood" and the phrase "Hellscream's eyes upon you". Prior to the Pandaria expedition, he fought alongside Dezco and Chezin Dawnchaser on several Horde missions, spanning multiple continents. Although he has respect for Dezco, he is dismissive of the Sunwalkers as a whole, referring to their way as "pacifist sun spirit filth". His mindset is more aggres
Kora is Liza Galestride's pet fox, found at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.
Koupal Oilshins is a Mechagon mechagnome located at Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.
Kram Kelada is a goblin located at Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island.
Krag'wa's Wrath is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Korenth is a sylvar located in Ardenweald. He is first seen in Wildseed Rescue, saving a wildseed for Lady Moonberry. Korenth is later seen in Heartswood Grove, having given his life to protect the Heart of the Grove from the possessed fae and Drust forces.

Kowalskos is a steward located at Kowalskos' Workshop in Bastion. Despite not being able to fly, his wish was granted in the Font of Fealty in the Seat of the Archon where a Generous Ascended flies with him.

__NOTOC__ Korrim the Cunning is a necromancer of the House of Rituals located in the northeastern Blighted Scar in Maldraxxus, kneeling before an altar with a dead Slime Giant and the banner of the House of Constructs. He was sent to the House of Plagues by Margrave Sin'dane and assisted in some of their most volatile creations, but Plague Deviser Marileth also noticed him skulking around for their most sensitive experiments shortly before the catastrophe that destroyed most of the house.

, and Anduin looking out at Korthia from Torghast.]] Korthia, City of Secrets is an ancient realm of the Shadowlands that was long lost in the In-Between before being dragged into the Maw by the chains of the Jailer. Similar to Oribos, Korthia is inhabited by attendants but also its own strange creatures, and the area contains many mysteries and secrets of the First Ones. The Jailer is searching for these secrets in the hopes of finding the key to fulfill his twisted vision for the Shadowlands. Korthia was hidden away in the In-Between to hide things that the races of the Shadowlands didn't want people like the Jailer to find. Korthia was controlled by the Fatescribe Roh-Kalo and an Archivis
Kotheshal is a dracthyr located in Stormwind City. She and Krozhalan can be found enjoying ice cream near the entrance to the Stormwind Stockade where they overlook Lion's Rest.
__NOTOC__ Korthrox the Destroyer is a proto-dragon located in the Azure Span.

Krug Skullsplit is an orc quest ender located at the Hive'Regal Horde camp in Silithus. He is involved in the Field Duty (Horde) quest. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, as several bodies of the Orgrimmar Legion were found in the destroyed Silithus, it is unclear if Krug Skullsplit managed to escape or perished as well.
Kray is a tauren located in Bena's Alchemy on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Kruban Darkblade was a wandering orc quest giver found in the Valley of Strength of Orgrimmar.

Krulmoo Fullmoon was a tauren leatherworking trainer in Camp Taurajo who was killed when the Alliance attacked. Winnoa Pineforest sent adventurers to summon his spirit and put it to rest for Honoring the Dead.
Krond is an orc meat vendor located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Krathok Moltenfist is an orc located in the Burning Anvil in the Valley of Honor in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. He presents blacksmiths with the option to specialize in armorsmithing or weaponsmithing. He can be seen speaking with Kalo Broadhorn.
Kroum is a wind rider flight master found at Valormok and in Bilgewater Harbor of Azshara. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Krexcil is the flight master located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.
Kraxx is a goblin zeppelin engineer located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He holds a zeppelin tracker in his right hand and is the brother of Krixx who works in Orgrimmar.

Kristoff was the Chamberlain of Theramore three years after the Battle of Mount Hyjal. While Jaina Proudmoore was the acknowledged ruler of Theramore, Kristoff did the day-to-day administrative work. He was a forthright person with a high capacity for irritating minutiae, his organizational skills legendary. Before the Third War, Kristoff served as a clerk for Grand Marshal Garithos, and served as one of his advisors after the fall of Lordaeron. Kristoff and the other advisors strongly urged Garithos to reconsider his alliance with the Forsaken, believing them to be treacherous. By the time Kristoff was proven right and Garithos met his end at the hands of Varimathras, Kristoff had already l

Kril'fon, originally Kril and later Kril'jin, is brighter than the average troll. He is a hunter-trader, inducted into the Cult of the Damned. He wanders Northrend testing his strength against new creatures and collecting all manner of trophies, weapons, and other items. Kril'fon once crossed the Dragonblight and approached Icecrown Citadel. Kril'fon hated the Scourge, but when an undead creature hailed him Kril'fon was intrigued. The lich Ra'sal discussed a plan to conquer Gundrak. The lich swayed the troll to his cause. Krendle Bigpockets is a goblin zeppelin master located in the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff. He gives information about The Zephyr. After the Fourth War, Zekhan relayed Gazlowe's message to Krendle, asking where the Steamwheedle travel profits went during the days of Trade Prince Gallywix. He swore on his family name that he had nothing to do with it and thought Zekhan's question a stab in his heart of gold. He also said that as flights have picked up again, profit streams should be flowing back to Orgrimmar soon.
Krennan Aranas is the Royal Chemist of Gilneas. Genn notes him as one of the most powerful chemists in Azeroth, or at least Gilneas.

Krom'gar Log Book is a quest item found on the ground around Mirkfallon Lake in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Krom'gar Assassins are level 27 - 28 Horde mobs inhabiting the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains. They are located near the Alliance entrance of the mine. They are normally stealthed.

Krom'gar Quartermaster is an orc quest giver for the Horde outpost of Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains. He sells armor to those that have completed at least Krom'gar Fortress (quest), and offers new items for every rank gained in Overlord Krom'gar's army.
Krom'gar Marauders are level 28 - 29 Horde soldiers in the Greatwood Vale in Stonetalon Mountains. They are fighting the Grimtotem.

Kronn was a large stone giant in the service of the Pantheon. During an ancient battle in Darkshore he and 19 other stone giants were set against the powerful Soggoth the Slitherer. Presumably after the other giants were slain, Kronn allowed himself to be entangled by Soggoth's tendrils -- just long enough to be lifted close enough to the creature's skull and within reach of his mighty sword. Kronn left the sword embedded in Soggoth's remains and the area around the massive weapon became known as the Master's Glaive.
Kressu is a draenei found in conversation with Jafu Windsword in the Shrine of Seven Stars.

Kril'Mandar Point is a small rocky outcrop found southwest of the Cradle of Chi-Ji in southwestern Krasarang Wilds. Its top sports two trees and a large pearlescent shell, Kril'mandar's Emblem. The point cannot be scaled, but the top can be reached by flying mount.

Krix Wiklish was a goblin emissary who came to Capital City shortly before the Invasion of Draenor. Krix was sitting at the breakfast table with the kings of Lordaeron and Stromgarde. Ambassador Muradin Bronzebeard, unaware of what was going on, heard Thoras argue with the goblin about trading supplies with him. Despite the goblin race's pledge of neutrality, one of their cartels had allied with the Horde during the Second War, however, and beyond Terenas nobody yet accepted to deal with them. Noticing that the two human kings had no interest in him, Krix then tried to persuade Muradin to trade with his people, trying to sell him his shredders. Krom'gar Peon are orc peons located in Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains. They do menial labor under the orders of Overlord Krom'gar, including transporting ore out of the mine. As is common for peons, they are not very intelligent. When they are carrying ore they will not attack Alliance, although if attacked they will fight back.
Krom'gar Infantry are orcs located in Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains. They fight under the orders of Overlord Krom'gar.
The Krasari clan is a clan of mogu found in the Krasari Ruins of Krasarang Wilds. This clan seems to favor the use of poisons and shadow magic.
Krystel is a pandaren vendor located on the Shrine of Seven Stars in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
The Krom'gar are the Horde forces in Stonetalon Mountains, named after and led by Overlord Krom'gar. They are based in Krom'gar Fortress.
Krom'gar Witch Doctors are jungle trolls located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Blood Guards are Horde soldiers located in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Berserkers are orcs located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Demolishers are demolishers located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Enforcers are orcs located in various points in Stonetalon Mountains. Some of them are mounted on a wolf.
Krom'gar Incinerators are orcs located in Windshear Crag in Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Loggers are goblins located in the Battlescar Valley in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Riflemen are tauren located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Krom'gar Warriors are tauren located in Stonetalon Mountains.
Krazzworks Sky Marshalls are goblins located aboard the zeppelin flying between Dragonmaw Port and the Krazzworks in the Twilight Highlands.

Krenzen is a dracthyr located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. He is found with Blue and Berkeley.
Krozhalan is a dracthyr located in Stormwind City. He and Kotheshal can be found enjoying ice cream near the entrance to the Stormwind Stockade where they overlook Lion's Rest.

__NOTOC__ Kretchenwrath is a proto-dragon flying at Froststone Vault and Scaleborn Pass in the Forbidden Reach. Later, he serves as the boss of the :Suffusion Camp: Cinderwind during Fyrakk Assaults. Killing him allows players to loot the Head of Kretchenwrath, which starts Disciple of Fyrakk: Kretchenwrath.

Kruthix is a blue drakonid flight master located in the Cobalt Assembly in the Azure Span. She has connections to Theron's Watch, Rhonin's Shield, Camp Antonidas, and Three-Falls Lookout in the Azure Span; Forkriver Crossing and Pinewood Post in the Ohn'ahran Plains; and Garden Shrine in Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ Krolkoth the Mountain is a proto-dragon located in the Waking Shores.

Kurdran Wildhammer is a famed gryphon rider who was Chief Thane of the Wildhammer clan during the Second War and one of the heroes of the Alliance Expedition to Draenor. He is a quest ender in Shadowmoon Valley and a quest giver in the Twilight Highlands.
Kurm Stonehoof is a tauren mining vendor located on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Kulwia is a tauren trade goods vendor located in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Kul'galar Keep is a vrykul keep built into the mountains near Balargarde Fortress in western Icecrown. Within it reside the oracles of Jotunheim who receive orders from their master and scry upon others through the Eye of the Lich King. The Bone Witch sends the player to use the eye to discover the Lich King's plans and thus she finds out about the discovery of the ancient vrykul hero, Iskalder.

The kunchong are enormous insects that are part of the mantid race. They are massive, violent, and without a question the biggest threat to the pandaren of the Townlong Steppes. Only Niuzao stands a chance against them, and possibly powerful adventurers.

Kyle Radue is a level 85 night elf that can be found in the Canals of Stormwind City. He's holding in his hands a seemingly-almost-KO Chris Miller and is strangely part of the Gnomeregan faction. Travis Nichols is standing just next to him.

__NOTOC__ Ku-Mo is the son of Ku-Yao. He tasked adventurers with saving his father, who was trapped in the Feeding Pits on Sra'vess. Ku-Mo can be seen in the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle with his father. Ku-Mo will sell a few kites as a vendor. Ku-Mo has traveled to Kul Tiras where he can be found with other kite enthusiasts such as Cynthia Cloudwhisper in the mountains of Stormsong Valley. He traveled to the Waking Shores, where he can be found along with Travis Moreau, Cynthia Cloudwhisper and a jug of Slam Bam Swill in a tree in the Crumbling Cliffs.

Kunzen Village is the home of the Kunzen hozen tribe, led by Chief Yip-Yip, and can be found atop the Skyrange in northwestern Valley of the Four Winds. It is accessible only by flying mount. The Kunzen Cave is further to the northeast, and further along the ridge to the east from there is Springtail Crag.

The Kunzen are a tribe of hozen found atop the Skyrange overlooking the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds, and in Kunza-Kunza on the Uncharted Island in the Great Sea. The group from the Skyrange have been raiding the nearby farms and causing trouble for the Tillers, while those from Kunza-Kunza hoard :Azerite.

Ky-Le the Traveller is a level 90 Huojin pandaren from the Wandering Isle. At some point he decided to travel to the southeastern Jade Forest where he can be found on a small island, fishing in the Mistveil Sea.
Kurong Caskhead is a pandaren bartender located at the Shrine of Two Moons in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Kwiven Quickcog is a goblin flight master found at Pinchwhistle Gearworks of Spires of Arak. He has a gyrocopter.
Kurloth is a jailer located in the Vault of the Wardens. He can be briefly seen during the demon hunter starting experience.
Kubrul is a drogbar located in the Deep Roads in Highmountain.
Kul'galar Oracles are vrykul located in Kul'galar Keep in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.
Kunza-Kunza is a hozen village on the Uncharted Island. It is home to members of the Kunzen tribe.
Kunzen Hozen are hozen located in Kunza-Kunza on the Uncharted Island and other expedition isles.
Kunzen Leafeaters are hozen located in Kunza-Kunza on the Uncharted Island and on Un'gol Ruins.

Kuzzambi of the Deep is a skeletal troll located underwater between the western and central docks in the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. She alternates between sitting on top of a rock and looking off into the deeper ocean and walking over to and inspecting a nearby pile of crates.
Kul Tiras Adventurers are humans and Dark Iron dwarves that are traveling to Kul Tiras by using the portal found in Wizard's Sanctum of Stormwind City.
Kul Tiran Representatives are humans located in Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.
Kunchong Destroyers are kunchong located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. __NOTOC__
Kula the Thunderer is a gorilla located in Island Expeditions.

Kul'Tiras Marine Issue Boots can be fished from the Broken Isles waters by using the Underlight Angler fishing pole with the Better Luck Next Time trait. It can also be fished from the Hyper-Compressed Ocean.

Kurazidaia is a dracthyr and envoy of the Healing Wings. She is located at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken and begins the patch 10.0.7 portion of the Dragonflight campaign, sending players to the Forbidden Reach.

Lady Callow was a Forsaken quest giver located in the Valley of Spirits in the orcish city of Orgrimmar.
Lady Sesspira is a rare naga found in a shrine at the Shattered Strand in Azshara.
Lady Szallah is a rare naga found in western in the Ruins of Feathermoon in Feralas. Prior to the Isle of Dread sinking beneath the surface, she was located within the cave there with Lord Shalzaru.
__NOTOC__ Laando is a draenei hippogryph flight master located at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.
L'lura Goldspun is a blood elf banker located at the southeastern Terrace of Light bank in Shattrath City.
Lady Dena Kennedy can be found in Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest. Before coming to Outland, she was originally found in the Royal Gallery in Stormwind City looking at the paintings.
Lady Shav'rar is a naga found at Coilskar Point in Shadowmoon Valley.
"LAVA BLAST - by Pyroco" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.

Lady Sira'kess is one of the key leaders of the naga in the underwater zone of Vashj'ir. She is seen in the various Battlemaiden visions, courtesy of Earthen Ring member Wavespeaker Valoren. During Defending the Rift, adventurers and Alliance/Horde forces briefly clash with her at the Abyssal Breach, where she is killed.

__NOTOC__ The ghost of Lady Benel'derath stands in the Ruins of Eldre'thar in Stonetalon Mountains. She and the other ghosts in the ruins seem to relive moments in their lives. Benel'derath is seen talking to Lord Ro'minate.

The Kzzok Warcamp can be found on the southeast side of Sra'vess, itself off the west coast of Townlong Steppes in the Westersea. The warcamp defends the Sra'vess side of the broken bridge from the Niuzao Temple island.

__NOTOC__ Lady Silisthra is one of the two naga witches masterminding the assault on the Southern Rocketway Terminus. She is located near Silisthra's Power Stone at the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara.
Lady Sena is a Forsaken assistant of Monte Gazlowe. She was first encountered in Frostwall. Later, she appeared in Dazar'alor and the Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Lady Anastae can be found at the The Grand Promenade in the city of Suramar. She is the widow of a famous gem cutter.
Lady Carraway is a Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
Lady Klipspringer is a Forsaken attending Mistress Matilda's party on the terrace above the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
Lady Missra is a naga that engaged in combat with Shandris Feathermoon but was taken out by the champions of the Unseen Path.
Lady Meredith Waycrest was the matriarch of House Waycrest. She made a pact with the Drust, seeking to use their power to save her ailing husband.
Lady Moonshade is one of the main characters of A Steamy Romance Novel: Of Elven Bondage.
Kyyxl was an imp located near Shattrath City. He was rumored that he could drive a follower insane by just looking at them. He was taken out by them.

Lady Anastae's husband was a nightborne Masterwork Gemcutter who lived in Suramar City in Suramar. His finest project was the magistrix cut, a design of great value he'd written in a tome. For this gem, he would be killed by Lespin Silverleaf for refusing to tell him where his tome is. His wife, Lady Anastae would bury her beloved in a cave called the Gemcutter's Tomb where his body rests to this day, along with the tome for the magistrix cut. His book would be recovered by an adventurer and given Apprentice Ardrias after Lespin Silverleaf was slain.
Lady Chaton is a nightborne located in the Midnight Court in the Court of Stars where she lives with her manakittens.

Lag is a situation that arises when communication between the game client and your character's server is delayed. This can be caused by many things: a slow internet connection, ISP troubles, power outages, highly-populated servers, etc. When you encounter lag all forms of interaction with the game world, such as fighting, looting, and talking to NPCs, will occur erratically or not at all. Lag typically dissipates after some time. After the lag goes away any damage caused or taken by your character will occur rapidly and other characters and mobs may appear to move very quickly. Lake Elune'ara is a large body of crystal water that covers the central part of the Moonglade. The mad demigod Omen, defeated many centuries ago, yet resides in Lake Elune'ara.

Lake Nazferiti is a lake in Northern Stranglethorn. Bordering it is a large base of the goblin Venture Company. It features many frenzies and crocolisks in its waters. Nazferiti river, which flows through the lake, may be the longest on the southern Eastern Kingdoms with a confirmed source at a waterfall in Redridge Mountains and unconfirmed headwaters within Deadwind Pass.

Land's End Beach is the most southern point of the Tanaris Desert, in the far southeastern tip of Kalimdor. Surf Gliders and Duneshore Crabs can be found on the eastern side of the beach, while Crazed Bilgewater Survivors and the wreckage of their ships can be found on the western side. The Bilgewater goblins that crashed here were originally headed to Gadgetzan but do not realize they landed on Kalimdor, thinking they are on an uncharted island instead. They have gone insane because of this and will attack anyone that approaches them. A crashed bomber lies on the eastern coast as well, where a rare goblin, Fronkle the Disturbed, sometimes appears. Lakeridge Highway is an old highway that runs along the southern edge of Lake Everstill in Redridge Mountains. The highway was originally highly traveled in the days before the First War. Since orcs have taken over Stonewatch Keep the highway has fallen into disuse. Now gnolls patrol most of the highway and travel on the road is not recommended. After the Cataclysm, the gnolls in the area have established more camps southeast of Lakeshire. There are also camouflaged Blackrock Hunters further down the road.
__NOTOC__ Lalina Summermoon is a night elf located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Landslide is an elite mountain giant boss found in Maraudon.

Lake Mennar is one of the few places in the world where the blue dragonflight can be found outside of Northrend. The only comparable place is Mazthoril in Winterspring. Although most of the region on all sides of the lake is inhabited by dragonspawn, the actual lake itself is free from danger and can provide solace and refreshment to those who are brave enough to get through the perimeter dragonkin. After the Cataclysm, Malynea Skyreaver provides some insight into the lake's origins: After the Fourth War, Zekhan and Rexxar visited the place and mentioned in his report that the blue dragons were still present in the area and concluded that this lake remains a special place for them. The Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains is a well-known establishment, and has kept its warm atmosphere despite the town's beleaguered state. It is a popular spot to sit down and have a chat and a drink of wine or ale, and the inn also offers bedrest to the weary traveler. During the Fourth War, Mathias Shaw gave the guards of Three Corners a night off. One of them got drunk and Darcy Parker put him into a bed in the inn. Before returning to his post duty, he left a mess there, leaving Innkeeper Brianna busy with cleaning. The Lakeshire Town Hall in the Redridge Mountains is an old building that has been diligently refurbished several times. The town hall is commonly the seat of rule by the local magistrate, and the current magistrate, Solomon, is a kind and wise ruler. The town's problems with gnolls and Blackrock orcs has put him in a state of desperation, however, and he readily accepts aid from helpful adventurers.
Lamar Veisilli is a human fruit vendor located in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains.
